item.title: fix: remove delivery markers from historical sessions (#124888)
item.summary: fix: remove delivery markers from historical sessions (#124888) * fix(sessions): migrate historical transcript directives * fix(infra): complete directive migration on pre-archives-schema databases session_transcript_archives is a lazy additive v17 surface; valid databases may omit it. The archives phase now treats the missing table as empty and completes the cursor instead of warning-skipping the whole database forever. Verified against a real long-lived agent DB: previously stuck cursor completes with zero warnings in ~100ms. * chore(ci): allow directive migration SQLite access
